summary.tldr: Raises the federal tax credits for volunteer firefighters and search and rescue volunteers from $3,000 to $10,000, starting with the 2022 tax year.
what_it_does: Raises the volunteer firefighter tax credit under the Income Tax Act from $3,000 to $10,000.
Raises the search and rescue volunteer tax credit under the Income Tax Act from $3,000 to $10,000.
Makes the new credit amounts apply to the 2022 tax year and later.
summary.background: The bill changes two tax credit rules in the Income Tax Act. It increases the amount used to calculate each credit.
